briefs.text: Tainted alcohol: 11 dead, 180+ in hospital
Funeral boat capsizes: 4 dead, incl. 2 children
Old mortar shell kills 4 students
Ex-PM Han's 15-yr sentence overturned; retrial
Bukele to register for third term; vote 28 Feb
Court lets TPS end for ~600,000 Venezuelans
Forest fires burned 7.1m acres in 2026
Man found guilty of starting Palisades fire
Kryvyi Rih strikes: 2 dead, 42 hurt
Plan advances for West Bank city of 200,000
Perseverance + Mars Odyssey science paused
Liquidations $2bn+; Bitcoin $58,076, -5.6%
Indian national gets 19 years in US, Pannun plot
Salvadoran military: 3 die after explosion
Foreign investment in tech rises 31%
Leapmotor Q3 profit -73%, at 40m yuan
WeRide revenue +88% on robotaxis; still a loss
Computer outages, cyberattacks continue
Migrant boat sinks: dozens missing off coast
Floods leave six dead across Kenya
IMF staff deal unlocks about $2.3bn
Quake felt here and in northern Australia
Somalia expels UAE ambassador in row
Zelenskyy calls Putin 'a killer' at APEC

edition.footer_claim: Every story here happened, or was first reported, on Saturday 21 November 2026. Claims are attributed, not stated as fact.
edition.footer_sources: Sources: AP, Horizon, BMKG, USGS, GFZ, Reuters, UN News, EU Council, UK Telegraph, BBC.  Original drawings.
